jobs.occupation: Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Field Service (Business-Analyst/in)

Optimization.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process-mapping sessions, and refinement meetings to analyze Design and Salesforce Configuration- Design functional solutions for Salesforce Field Service, Service Cloud, and Platform capabilities with Product Owners, architects, developers, integration or proof-of-concept configurations and conduct end-to-end impact assessments covering processes, data, integrations, automation, reporting, permissions, mobile use, and dependent platform streams.- Components, or other coded solutions are required, as software development is outside this role.Technical Service Process Ownership Support- Act as a functional expert for Technical Service, Field Service, and Service Cloud processes and capabilities, including case lifecycle, routing and queues, email and service channels, Work Order Management, Scheduling, the Field Service Mobile App, automation, and service reporting.- Promote consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems.- Advance reusable global templates and capabilities while enabling justified, controlled localization, and identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the evaluation and responsible adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities for Customer Service and Field Service use cases, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results from requirements and acceptance criteria; prepare and execute functional testing and support system integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness assessments, deployment preparation, release notes, and post-deployment validation, and provide hypercare by prioritizing incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancement demands.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Technical Service stakeholders, communicate effectively with business and technical audiences, and facilitate alignment and decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Collaborate with local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, and end-user support, providing expert guidance on complex or escalated topics and supporting process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Technical Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, accounts, work orders, assets, locations, and product items.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service-performance monitoring, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement; analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify opportunities.- Provide expert-level functional support for complex or escalated Technical Service topics and coordinate with technical teams as required.Your qualifications- University degree in business administration, economics, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least 5 years of professional experience in Business Analysis, CRM, Technical Service, commercial operations, or a related environment (preferably Pharma or Life Sciences), including at least 3 years of hands-on Salesforce Field Service experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or in a comparable role.- Proven experience in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshop facilitation, user-story writing, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment.- Hands-on knowledge of Salesforce declarative configuration and low-code capabilities, including Salesforce Flow, with the ability to implement controlled changes without code and assess automation impacts, error handling, maintainability, and testing needs.- Solid understanding of jobs.description: Worldwide Sales & New Business Development Neschen, part of Henkel, develops and manufactures self-adhesive graphic media and coating solutions. jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content GenerationYou are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.Your Profile- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs- natural language generation and explainability- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.Funding & Appointment TermsThe appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:- Monthly stipend of €1,650- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)Application Details- Expected start date: February, 2026Application package must include:- Curriculum Vitae (CV)- Academic transcripts- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals- 2 recommendation lettersApplications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Wir geben dir die notwendige Zeit und den Raum, um die Entwicklung jedes Kindes bewusst zu begleiten und zu dokumentieren.Kontinuierliche WeiterbildungWir glauben an lebenslanges Lernen. Regelmäßige Fortbildungen und 8 fest eingeplante Konzepttage pro Jahr geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine pädagogischen Kompetenzen zu erweitern und dich persönlich sowie beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.Ein internationales TeamDu wirst Teil eines vielfältigen und internationalen Teams, in dem unterschiedliche Kulturen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven geschätzt werden. Wir ermutigen dich, deine eigenen Ideen einzubringen und etwas zu bewegen.Digital & unkompliziertUnsere Glückskinder-App übernimmt viele organisatorische Aufgaben im Alltag und gibt dir dadurch mehr Zeit und Energie für das, worauf es wirklich ankommt: die Kinder.Attraktives Gehalt & zusätzliche LeistungenWir schätzen deine Arbeit und dein Engagement. Neben einem leistungsorientierten Gehalt erwarten dich unter anderem eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, ein Fahrtkostenzuschuss, JobRad und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.🌴 Flexible UrlaubsplanungDa es nur wenige festgelegte Schließzeiten pro Jahr gibt, hast du mehr Flexibilität bei der Planung deines Urlaubs und kannst Beruf und Privatleben besser miteinander vereinbaren.✨ Das bringst du mit- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Erzieher/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Pädagogik, Frühpädagogik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und echte Freude daran, täglich mit Kindern Englisch zu sprechen- Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau sind zwingend erforderlich- Leidenschaft für die Arbeit mit Kindern im Alter von 6 Monaten bis 6 Jahren- Einfühlungsvermögen, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und ausgeprägte pädagogische Fähigkeiten- Kreativität und viele Ideen, um den Alltag und das Lernen abwechslungsreich und spannend zu gestalten- Offenheit für neue pädagogische Ansätze sowie die Bereitschaft, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickelnWerde Teil der Glückskinder-Familie – und hilf Kindern dabei, zu wachsen, zu entdecken und sich zu entfalten.

You do not need to speak German – English skills at B1 level or above are sufficient.Die vorliegende Stelle ist im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung zu besetzen.Package Sorter (m/f/d) – English Speaking Applicants Welcome in KoblenzIhre Aufgaben:• Sort incoming parcels and prepare them for further distribution.• Remove parcels from conveyor belts and place them in the designated sorting areas.• Scan parcels using handheld barcode scanners.• Support daily warehouse operations at the logistics facility in Koblenz-Metternich.• Work closely with your colleagues to ensure a smooth and efficient parcel sorting process.• Keep your working area clean, safe and organised.Ihre Qualifikationen:• You are reliable, punctual and enjoy working as part of a team.• You are physically fit and comfortable handling parcels.• You are available to work at least 2 days per week.• You must be able to reach the workplace independently by 4:00 AM. Public transport connections are limited at this early hour.• English language skills at B1 level or above are required. German language skills are not necessary.• Previous warehouse experience is an advantage but not essential. Career changers and applicants without previous experience are welcome!Was Sie erwartet:• Attractive hourly pay: €14.96 gross per hour between 6:00 AM and 8:00 AM, plus a 25% shift premium for working between 4:00 AM and 6:00 AM.• Flexible working days: Work between 2 and 5 days per week, depending on your availability.• Fixed working hours: Tuesday to Saturday, from 4:00 AM to 8:00 AM.• Free afternoons: Finish work early and enjoy the rest of your day.• Weekends off on Sundays and Mondays: Benefit from a predictable weekly schedule.• Flexible employment options: Choose between a mini-job or part-time employment.• International team: English-speaking applicants are very welcome.Apply now and become part of our team in Koblenz-Metternich. We look forward to receiving your application!\n\nSämtliche Personenbezeichnungen gelten gleichermaßen für alle Geschlechter.

jobs.occupation: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) (Recruiter/in)
jobs.description: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d)Kelvion- Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.Together, We Shape the FutureYour responsibilities- Lead full-cycle recruitment efforts for selected specialist, management and senior roles in EMEA, with a particular focus on IT, Digital, Finance, Controlling, Accounting and Corporate Functions- Building relationships with Hiring Managers to understand the current and future needs of the business, helping to shape a proactive recruitment strategy accordingly, particularly for IT and Finance-related hiring needs- Actively developing talent pools through proactive searching and sourcing of talent using advertising, referrals, social media platforms, LinkedIn, professional networks, specialist communities and networking events- Creating and utilising best in class and innovative solutions to help fill niche and senior roles, especially in competitive IT, Digital and Finance talent markets- Managing the process with candidates from engagement to on boarding including offer process across all levels of the business, working with local HR teams ensuring compliance with all local employment law legislation- Securing talent that fits our company culture, adheres to the current needs of the business and role and future growth opportunities.- Acting as a true business partner to support local HR colleagues with recruitment opportunities, market insights and guidance on hiring feasibility- Proactively research market conditions, undertake competitor analysis, gain insight from peers, network, and via candidate relationships, including salary expectations, talent availability and competitor activity in relevant EMEA markets- Working with our Marketing team on recruitment branding, social media posts, and other ideas to raise our employer profile.- Enhancing our employee value proposition and refining our go-to-market strategy by collaborating closely with colleagues across the business- Driving the referrals program and networking events, with a focus on increasing access to qualified IT, Finance and Corporate Functions talent- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of research, reports, and intelligence in a centralized databaseYour profile- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification- Proven talent acquisition experience, minimum 5 years in search, agency, or in house, with a passion for the dynamic nature of recruitment including substantial time in house. Previous experience within search would be beneficial- Proven experience recruiting for IT and/or Finance roles, ideally across several EMEA markets- Experience working across the EMEA region and understanding of the regional talent markets- Solid understanding of typical profiles in IT, Digital, Finance, Controlling, Accounting or Corporate Functions- Deep knowledge of sourcing strategies and solid understanding of recruitment best practices incl. suitability diagnostics and structured candidate assessment methods- Excellent communication skills with the confidence to interact with candidates, colleagues, Hiring Managers and senior stakeholders- Prior experience in a manufacturing or products-based industry is highly desirable- Experience with ATS systems, e.g. SuccessFactors, and sourcing platform LinkedIn Recruiter- Fluent in English, written and spoken; additional European languages are a strong asset- An organised, adaptable, and proactive approach to talent acquisition with a strong sense of ownership and accountability- A passion for delivering a best-in-class candidate experience and continuously improving hiring strategies- The ability to document and present updates, market insights and candidate information with clarity, precision and flairAt Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.This is a fixed-term position for 12 months, offering the opportunity to contribute to Kelvion’s recruitment strategy with a strong focus on IT, Digital, Finance, Controlling, Accounting and Corporate Functions across EMEA.Together, We Shape the Future
